actual: Real HMM batch creation fails before persistence because build_source_manifest compares the filtered evaluation-window DataFrame length with the full Prediction Store manifest row_count. A 2025 window has 1,242,987 selected prediction rows versus 2,260,161 artifact rows; full-range h20 labels have 2,154,168 valid rows versus 2,260,161 stored rows after terminal NaN removal. Expected: preserve and verify full artifact identity separately from selected/effective row counts, and replay must validate both without weakening SHA/size/zero-copy checks.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
